# Source: original fixture

Authored for the Trustabl test corpus. Synthetic MCP client configs pairing
unscoped and scoped credentials (MCPCFG-004) and plain http and https or
loopback remote URLs (MCPCFG-005) across the client config files the engine
reads. Every host, package and project name is a fake placeholder under
`example`; tokens appear only as `${VAR}` references. No external code.
Public-domain.
